title: RIVX technical documents — engine, interfaces and rendering derivations
introduction: Four authored technical documents cover the renderer architecture, Rive interface implementations, rendering techniques and derivations behind the native 3D workflow. Their complete text and inline figures are retained; historical counts and implementation boundaries describe each source snapshot.

documents.title: Light through vectors — 3D rendering, baking and export
documents.role: Implementation-oriented deep dive into refraction, photon-lightmap normalization, Gaussian splats, shared drawables and Rive export. Measurements and implementation-status notes describe the recorded source snapshot; marked screenshot placeholders are unrecorded examples.

documents.title: RIVE+ engine — rendering and non-photorealistic techniques
documents.role: Technical overview of the two renderers, auxiliary buffers, stylization, spacetime volumes, vector beams, curve families and document format. This earlier snapshot predates the full native 3D story; effect counts and RIVX version numbers are historical, while “research-level” describes algorithmic difficulty rather than a claim of original research.

documents.title: API contracts and renderer interfaces
documents.role: Detailed separation of the official Rive runtime from the custom render-interface implementations, resource ownership, image decoding and binary export. Code excerpts and source line references describe the documented snapshot.

documents.title: Native architecture and module structure
documents.role: Architecture map of the official runtime, custom renderer, library graph, editor and test suites. File counts, library counts, source-line totals and the stated export scope describe this earlier source snapshot; consult the brochure for later 3D and browser-player capabilities.
